purpose: Repeatable synthetic observations of the unchanged AI on 12-versus-12 armies; timing has no pass/fail threshold.

config.random: 32-bit LCG: state = (1664525 * state + 1013904223) mod 2^32; random = state / 2^32
config.playerArmy: Unchanged initial 4 knights, 4 archers, 3 slimes plus king at all sampled floors; no reward-based optimization.

policies.wait-only: Player always waits. This is an intentionally passive control, not representative human play.
policies.mirrored-ai: Player uses chooseAI on a cloned state with side labels swapped; no production behavior changes.

config.timingScope: Only original enemy chooseAI calls; VM startup, mirrored-player decisions, engine.act, rendering and animation excluded.
config.progress: No-damage plies count consecutive successful actions without damage; a capture also deals damage.
config.captures: Count successful death events, including kings; rewardsCommitted counts only acquired nonking enemies.
config.reversal: A moving piece returns to its previous occupied square on its next move, regardless of intervening actors.
config.repeatedLayout: Side-to-move plus unit IDs/types/sides/positions/HP repeated; excludes AI history, so repetition alone is not a proven cycle.

limitations: Synthetic Node simulations do not establish human difficulty, overall balance, animation feel, or iPhone performance.
Clock timing, generatedAt, and environment vary between machines and runs; fixed seeds reproduce compositions and actions for the same engine.
Floors 1, 5 and 10 sample only three seeds and two fixed player policies. Floor 1 has a fixed enemy army, so its seeds repeat the same logical fight.
Observed waiting, reversals, or action-cap endings are reported without changing AI, turn timing, combat, or encounter weights.
